name: Why is custom basement framing handled differently in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Why is custom basement framing handled differently in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement framing in the Denver metro area requires special construction practices due to local soil conditions that cause concrete basement slabs to move. Contractors frequently frame floating walls, which leave a space between the bottom plate and the concrete floor, secured with specialty floating plate hardware. This prevents upward foundation movement from cracking drywall or buckling upper-level structural framing. Additionally, framing against perimeter foundation walls must account for proper clearance, vapor barriers, and insulation gaps to protect against moisture intrusion before drywall installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver area soils often require floating basement walls to absorb slab movement, along with moisture protection, preventing cracked drywall and structural stress.
